title: Crypto misuse: kcapi skcipher no AES key size validation
description: kcapi skcipher sess_init (src/providers/kcapi/kcapi_skcipher.c:61-65) passes keylen directly to crypto_skcipher_setkey without independently validating 16/24/32 bytes. wolfssl AES-CBC validates explicitly (wolfssl_aes_cbc.c:80-83). A caller can attempt to use a 1-byte key against kcapi; the kernel crypto API may or may not reject it depending on driver. FIPS 140-3 minimum is 128 bits (16 bytes). The kcapi provider must enforce this independently before delegating to kernel crypto API.
close_reason: Added FIPS 140-3 AES key size validation (16/24/32 bytes only) in kcapi_skcipher_sess_init before crypto_skcipher_setkey
